info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_File Payment Consent Retrieval API
info.description: The File Payment Consent Retrieval API allows clients to access file payment consent details within the open banking framework. This service supports the retrieval of consent data associated with specific payments, enabling businesses to verify and manage their financial transactions efficiently. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment service providers, and fintech applications that require secure access to consent information. With this API, developers can facilitate seamless payment operations and ensure compliance with banking regulations.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific file payment consent.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a specific file payment consent identified by its unique ID. It delivers the detailed information of the consent which can be further processed according to business needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the file payment consent details for the specified consent ID. The request expects a JSON payload that adheres to the schema defined for file payment consents.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the file payment consent.
